## Facts and limits
- Lury Beauty is a trading/sourcing service, not a claimed factory owner.
- Three actual photos show one sample labelled Girl Group 1.0, photographed 2026-09-21. The open tray shows 48 clusters in 6 rows of 8. It is not mapped to the illustrated W/B reference codes.
- W01-W04, B01-B04 and the concept library are visual discussion references, not evidence of material, adhesive, performance, stock or production availability.
- Buyers can request the photographed sample, a multi-style comparison or a branded packaging sample. These are inquiry routes, not fixed-price kits or guarantees of availability.
- MOQ, sample fees, freight and timing are confirmed for the actual item, packaging and destination. Quotes separate sample items, packaging/setup, freight and tax/duty inclusion; preparation and transit are separate stages.
- Vietnamese language on a sample pack does not establish product or import approval.
- WhatsApp: +86 183 6665 6532. Email: 2826347155@qq.com.
- A prepared WhatsApp/email inquiry is not sent until the buyer sends it in that service.
- No certification, local warehouse, free sample, fixed MOQ, wear/reuse promise or delivery guarantee should be inferred.

Reviewed: 2026-09-23.
